_units: items_per_second = wiki per-minute value / 60. Wiki infobox lists 5 belt levels 60/90/120/150/180 per minute; 3-value lists are infobox levels 3-5.

_measured.note: All three measured facts match the wiki 'ratio' field exactly; the wiki adds that ratios hold at every upgrade level because all rates scale together.

Conveyor Belt.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Conveyor Belt.rate_text: throughput=60 • 90 • 120 • 150 • 180 (infobox; Belt Reader page says 'rate of shapes per minute'). Shop table: Conveyer Belt 120/150/180 at Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%.
Conveyor Belt.mechanic: A belt tile carries one lane; splitters/mergers are belt tiles (ratio 1); lifts take exactly 1 input and 1 output and cannot split/merge.

Belt.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)

Belt Launcher.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Belt Launcher.rate_text: Belt Launcher and Catcher: throughput=60 • 90 • 120 • 150 • 180, ratio=1. Shop: Belt Launcher 120/150/180.
Belt Launcher.mechanic: Placed in pairs 1-4 empty tiles apart, same axis; launcher targets the furthest catcher in range; full-belt rate (ratio 1). On notches they feed Space Belt lanes.

Belt Catcher.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Belt Catcher.mechanic: Placed in pairs 1-4 empty tiles apart, same axis; launcher targets the furthest catcher in range; full-belt rate (ratio 1). On notches they feed Space Belt lanes.

Overflow Splitter.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Overflow Splitter.outputs: 2: straight-ahead priority, side only when straight is blocked
Overflow Splitter.mechanic: Prioritises the straight output; side output only receives when straight cannot accept (used to prevent back-up between Cutter and Stacker).

Half Destroyer.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Half Destroyer.rate_text: Half Destroyer: throughput=20 • 30 • 40 • 50 • 60, ratio=3. Shop: 40/50/60. 'it is the fastest one and does not produce extra outputs'
Half Destroyer.mechanic: Destroys the WEST half regardless of machine rotation; single output, nothing discarded to a side belt; 3 per belt.

Cutter.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Cutter.outputs: 2 front outputs: east half on main output, west half on secondary (adjacent tile)
Cutter.mechanic: Cuts vertically into east/west halves independent of rotation; 4 per belt; both halves leave on parallel front belts (mirrored variant swaps sides).

Swapper.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Swapper.mechanic: Swaps the west halves of the two input shapes; halves are placed side by side (not dropped) so crystals do not shatter; 4 per belt pair.

Rotator.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Rotator.mechanic: Rotates one part clockwise (90 deg in 4-part scenarios); 2 per belt; rotation does not matter to the Vortex.

Reverse Rotator.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Reverse Rotator.mechanic: Rotates one part counter-clockwise; 2 per belt.

180° Rotator.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)

Stacker.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Stacker.rate_text: Stacker: throughput=10 • 15 • 20 • 25 • 30, ratio=6; footprint 1 x 1 x 2; inouts=2 : 1. Shop: Stacker 20/25/30.
Stacker.inputs: 2: bottom-shape input on floor 0 rear, top-shape input on floor 1 rear (buildings.json: both Direction 2)
Stacker.outputs: 1 on floor 0; buildings.json StackerDefaultVariant outputs to the SIDE (Direction 3)
Stacker.mechanic: Top input falls onto bottom input; halves merge into one layer, full shapes stack; layers above 4 are discarded; falling crystals shatter. 6 per belt (slowest shape machine). NOTE: buildings.json id mapping to wiki 'Stacker' vs 'Stacker (Bent)' is best-effort: Default = side output, Straight = front output.

Bent Stacker.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Bent Stacker.rate_text: Stacker (Bent): throughput=15 • 22.5 • 30 • 37.5 • 45, ratio=4; researchcost=6. Shop: Bent Stacker 30/37.5/45.
Bent Stacker.mechanic: Researched variant, 1.5x the plain Stacker: 4 per belt. Same stacking rules. Id mapping best-effort (see Stacker).

Painter.levels_note: 3 values = infobox levels 3-5 (Shop Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%); machine unlocks after belt levels 1-2
Painter.rate_text: Painter: throughput=30 • 37.5 • 45; fluidinput=300 • 375 • 450; ratio=4; fluidratio=4. Shop: Painter 30/37.5/45.
Painter.inputs: 1 belt (rear of main tile) + 3 bidirectional pipe ports
Painter.mechanic: Paints only the TOP layer; refined parts, pins, crystals pass unchanged; pipe ports pass fluid through to neighbours; 4 per belt and 4 per pump (300 L/min each).

Color Mixer.levels_note: 3 values = infobox levels 3-5 (Shop Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%); machine unlocks after belt levels 1-2
Color Mixer.rate_text: fluidinput=300 • 375 • 450; fluidoutput=600 • 750 • 900; fluidratio=2. '60L of each input color results in 120L of the output color.'
Color Mixer.inputs: 2 fluid inputs (both must be supplied; consumed equally)
Color Mixer.mechanic: Volume is conserved; 2 mixers per fluid-launcher pipe. No shape throughput.

Pin Pusher.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Pin Pusher.mechanic: Adds pins under every non-empty bottom-layer part, then discards layers above 4; 3 per belt.

Crystal Generator.levels_note: 3 values = infobox levels 3-5 (Shop Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%); machine unlocks after belt levels 1-2
Crystal Generator.rate_text: Crystal Generator: throughput=20 • 25 • 30; fluidinput=400 • 500 • 600; ratio=6; fluidratio=3. Shop: 20/25/30.
Crystal Generator.mechanic: Fills every gap and pin up to the highest used layer with crystal of the fluid colour; 6 per belt, 3 per pump-equivalent (400 L/min each).

Polisher.mechanic: Manufacturer-mode only: turns half-blocks of unrefined waste into polished waste. No numbers on the wiki.

Trash.rate_text: 'there is no limit on how many shapes can be trashed'
Trash.mechanic: Accepts from all four sides, unlimited rate; floor 1 only.

Belt Filter.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Belt Filter.rate_text: Belt Filter: throughput=60 • 90 • 120 • 150 • 180, ratio=1; inouts=1 : 2; wire in 1
Belt Filter.mechanic: Full belt rate; shape signal -> matching shapes straight, others to side; null/conflict blocks; int 0 -> side, int !=0 -> straight.

Belt Reader.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Belt Reader.rate_text: Belt Reader: throughput=60 • 90 • 120 • 150 • 180, ratio=1. 'displays the rate of shapes per minute moving through it'
Belt Reader.mechanic: Pass-through at full belt rate; confirms wiki throughput units are shapes per minute.

Flow Control.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Flow Control.rate_text: Belt Reader/Filter throughput=60 • 90 • 120 • 150 • 180, ratio=1; Pipe Gate fluidinput/output=1200 • 1500 • 1800, fluidratio=1
Flow Control.inputs: see Belt Filter / Belt Reader / Pipe Gate
Flow Control.outputs: see Belt Filter / Belt Reader / Pipe Gate
Flow Control.mechanic: Wire-controlled routing at full belt / full pipe-launcher rate.

Extractor.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)

Mini-Miner.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Mini-Miner.rate_text: Mini-Miner: throughput=15 • 22.5 • 30 • 37.5 • 45, ratio=4; inouts=0 : 1. Shop: Mini-Miner 30/37.5/45.
Mini-Miner.inputs: 0 (sits on an extraction point of an Asteroid Miner)
Mini-Miner.mechanic: 4 mini-miners saturate one belt; an Asteroid Miner has 4 extraction points, +4 per Miner Booster up to 16 (= 4 belts).

Miner Booster.rate_text: Each additional booster provides 4 additional Mini-Miner locations, up to a total of 16.
Miner Booster.mechanic: Up to 3 boosters per Asteroid Miner; 16 mini-miners = 4 full belts per fully boosted miner (Space Transport page).

Mini Pump.levels_note: 3 values = infobox levels 3-5 (Shop Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%); machine unlocks after belt levels 1-2
Mini Pump.mechanic: 4 mini pumps saturate one fluid launcher (1200 L/min).

Pump Booster.mechanic: Analogous to Miner Booster for Asteroid Pumps (redirect target only).

Fluid Launcher.levels_note: 3 values = infobox levels 3-5 (Shop Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%); machine unlocks after belt levels 1-2
Fluid Launcher.rate_text: Fluid Launcher and Catcher: fluidinput=1200 • 1500 • 1800; fluidoutput=1200 • 1500 • 1800
Fluid Launcher.mechanic: Pairs 1-4 tiles apart; 1200 L/min per launcher = the 'full pipe' unit (fluidratio 1).

Fluid Catcher.levels_note: 3 values = infobox levels 3-5 (Shop Speed Multiplier 100/125/150%); machine unlocks after belt levels 1-2
Fluid Catcher.mechanic: Pairs 1-4 tiles apart; 1200 L/min per launcher = the 'full pipe' unit (fluidratio 1).

Fluid Producer.rate_text: fluidoutput=28800; fluidratio=24 • 19.2 • 16. 'produces the throughput of 24/19.2/16 Fluid Launchers'

Fluid Tank.rate_text: fluidinput=1200 • 1500 • 1800; fluidoutput=1200 • 1500 • 1800; fluidratio=1; 'stores up to 2,400 L'
Fluid Tank.mechanic: Buffer of 2,400 L; only fills from excess (consumers have priority).

Pipe.rate_text: 'Pipes actually contain no fluid and the transfer rate is unlimited.'
Pipe.mechanic: Omnidirectional, unlimited rate; splits/merges in all 4 directions.

Space Belt.rate_text: Each lane has a maximum throughput equal to the throughput of 4 belts... a space belt level (a group of 4 lanes) has the throughput of 16 belts... a full space belt has a throughput of 48 belts, which is equal to 4 Notches
Space Belt.mechanic: Space Belt lane = 4 belts. 12 independent lanes in 3 groups of 4 (group = launcher floor, lane = launcher position in the notch); each lane = 4 belts, a floor group = 16 belts, a full space belt = 48 belts = 4 notches.

Space Transport.rate_text: Each lane has a maximum throughput equal to the throughput of 4 belts... a space belt level (a group of 4 lanes) has the throughput of 16 belts... a full space belt has a throughput of 48 belts, which is equal to 4 Notches
Space Transport.mechanic: Space Belt lane = 4 belts. 12 independent lanes in 3 groups of 4 (group = launcher floor, lane = launcher position in the notch); each lane = 4 belts, a floor group = 16 belts, a full space belt = 48 belts = 4 notches.

Space Pipe.rate_text: Each lane has a maximum throughput equal to the throughput of 24 fluid launchers... a space pipe level (a group of 4 lanes) has the throughput of 96 fluid launchers... a full space pipe has a throughput of 288 fluid launchers
Space Pipe.mechanic: One-directional; lane = 24 fluid launchers (28,800 L/min at level 1).

Space Platforms.rate_text: Notches... 12 fully saturated Belts for Shapes or 12 fully saturated Fluid Launchers for Fluids, since that's the most a single notch can handle
Space Platforms.footprint: chunk = 20x20 tiles; notch = 1x4 buildable, 3 levels tall
Space Platforms.inputs: notch: 4 wide x 3 floors = 12 belt positions
Space Platforms.mechanic: A notch carries at most 12 belts (4 positions x 3 floors); only launchers/catchers/wireless go on notches.

Machine Platforms.inputs: 4-tile notch centred on each chunk edge
Machine Platforms.mechanic: Edges set back 3 tiles from the chunk border; smallest platform builds 14x14.

Vortex.rate_text: The Vortex Platform has 12 Notches around its outer perimeter, allowing to deliver up to 144 belts of shapes... twelve, 3-level ports on each of the four sides... only 4 ports on each side are available when starting
Vortex.inputs: 12 notches x 12 belts = 144 belts max; 4 of 12 ports per side at start, more via 3rd Machine Level + Vortex Inputs upgrade
Vortex.mechanic: Delivery cap = 144 belts; rotation ignored; pins sometimes ignored.

Trains.rate_text: if you are at train capacity level 1 (3 packages per wagon) and you are feeding the shape loader using 4 fully saturated 90 items/min belts per level, then it will take 60 seconds to fill one 360-item package per level
Trains.mechanic: Package = 360 items per level; wagon = 3 packages at capacity level 1; round-trip must beat fill time or the loader backs up.

Trade Stations.mechanic: Exchange shapes; only source of refined X/Y parts. No rates given.

Item Producer.levels_note: levels 1-5 of the wiki infobox (Shop 'Speed Multiplier' 100/125/150% = infobox levels 3/4/5)
Item Producer.rate_text: Item Producer: throughput=60 • 90 • 120 • 150 • 180, ratio=1. 'produces a full belt of any shape'
Item Producer.mechanic: Sandbox source: exactly one saturated belt of a configured shape code (any parts/layers).

Sandbox Machines.mechanic: Needs cheats + CBSandbox research; Item Producer = 1 belt, Fluid Producer = 24 launchers.

Shape Machines.mechanic: Toolbar index page only; numbers live on the per-machine pages.

Shape Processing.mechanic: Toolbar index page only; numbers live on the per-machine pages.

Simulated Machines.mechanic: Wire-only: transform shape/color SIGNALS with the same rules as the real machines; no item throughput. Stacker: left input stacks on top of right (mirrored swaps). Unstacker: top layer left, rest right. Painter/Crystal: shape rear, color side.

Upgrades.rate_text: Speed Multiplier levels 1/2/3 = 100%/125%/150%: Conveyer Belt 120/150/180, Belt Launcher 120/150/180, Rotators 60/75/90, Half Destroyer 40/50/60, Pin Pusher 40/50/60, Mini-Miner 30/37.5/45, Cutter 30/37.5/45, Swapper 30/37.5/45, Bent Stacker 30/37.5/45, Painter 30/37.5/45, Stacker 20/25/30, Crystal Generator 20/25/30 (per minute)
Upgrades.mechanic: All machine and fluid rates scale together with the Speed Multiplier, so ratios are level-independent.

Upgrade.mechanic: All machine and fluid rates scale together with the Speed Multiplier, so ratios are level-independent.

Operator Level.mechanic: Infinite goal lines; no machine rates.

3rd Machine Level.mechanic: Unlocks floor 3 (so a notch carries 12 belts, and more Vortex ports).

Glossary.rate_text: Ratio: the amount of machines required to process a full belt/pipe... always a whole number if the upgrades are at equal levels, e.g. 2 Rotators per belt. Throughput: usually quantified in shapes/litres per minute.
Glossary.mechanic: Defines 'ratio' = machines per full belt and confirms per-minute units.
